social_media.headline: G3–G4 Geomagnetic Storm Conditions Possible
social_media.summary: G3–G4 geomagnetic storm conditions are possible worldwide and in Earth's orbit. Higher-latitude regions face the greatest potential impacts.

confidence.label: Chance of Onset
confidence.detail: Storm onset is most likely between 1800 UTC Friday and 0600 UTC Saturday.

what_we_know: There is a 65% chance of G3 or greater conditions through early Monday.
There is a 20% chance of G4 or greater conditions.
Storm conditions may last 12 to 48 hours.
Additional CME influences are possible beyond the primary onset window.

footer.left: Next update by 2000 UTC Thursday, or sooner if conditions change.
footer.center: Review sector procedures and monitor SWPC updates.

visual.alt_text: Forecast visualization for possible G3–G4 geomagnetic storm conditions.
